replies.author: MajestysDream
replies.body:
Hello, Burdie! 

After taking your report into further examination, the fellow moderators and I have decided that this is not enough evidence for us to warrant a punishment, as this map is a 1 hit KO, and it could be just based on ping. If you can gather up more evidence, preferably on a map that is not 1 hit KO, that would be amazing! Thank you for taking the time to report, and thank you for your concern! :)
